analysis.overall: You spent 89% of your day in range with a beautifully flat overnight period, though stacking small correction doses after meals led to a couple of steep drops later on.

events.title: Post-lunch peak
events.description: Glucose rose to 186 mg/dL following your afternoon meal and a series of small stacked correction doses.

events.title: Post-dinner low
events.description: After a 50g carb dinner bolus, levels dipped down to 64 mg/dL before climbing back up ahead of bedtime.

events.title: Smooth overnight line
events.description: Your numbers stayed beautifully stable and flat between 75 and 100 mg/dL all through the night.

events.title: Waking drift low
events.description: Glucose gradually drifted down to 57 mg/dL before recovering on its own as your morning got underway.

events.title: Breakfast spike and midday crash
events.description: Breakfast and a few closely spaced correction doses bumped you up to 185 mg/dL before sending you down to 54 mg/dL at noon.

analysis.watch_for_tomorrow: Keep an eye on stacking correction doses during slow meal rises, as active insulin can catch up and cause sharp drops later.
